description: Return the words of s in reverse order, joined by single spaces.
tests:
assert rev_words('a b  c') == 'c b a'
assert rev_words('') == ''

description: Convert 1 <= n <= 3999 to a Roman numeral (subtractive notation).
tests:
assert to_roman(1994) == 'MCMXCIV'
assert to_roman(4) == 'IV'
assert to_roman(3999) == 'MMMCMXCIX'

assert rle('aaabcc') == 'a3b1c2'
assert rle('') == ''
assert rle('z') == 'z1'

description: Merge overlapping closed intervals given as (start, end) tuples; return a sorted list of tuples. Touching intervals (end == next start) merge.
tests:
assert merge_intervals([(5, 6), (1, 3), (2, 4)]) == [(1, 4), (5, 6)]
assert merge_intervals([(1, 2), (2, 3)]) == [(1, 3)]
assert merge_intervals([]) == []

description: True if s is a valid ISBN-10 (hyphens allowed and ignored; last char may be X meaning 10; weighted sum 10..1 divisible by 11).
tests:
assert isbn10_ok('0-306-40615-2')
assert not isbn10_ok('0-306-40615-3')
assert isbn10_ok('080442957X')
assert not isbn10_ok('12345')
